subject.title: Proposal: Publish a provider compatibility matrix with deprecation policy

question: Should OpenClaw commit to a public provider lifecycle matrix with stable/experimental/deprecated/broken statuses and deprecation windows across official, bundled, and community provider surfaces?
rationale: The change would create support guarantees and metadata ownership rules, not just fill a missing docs table or CLI field.

options.title: Approve scoped lifecycle registry
options.body: Create a provider lifecycle registry with clear owner rules, capability dimensions, deadlines, replacements, and issue links, then generate docs and doctor/models summaries from it.

options.title: Publish docs policy first
options.body: Start with a human-readable provider support and deprecation policy before adding a machine-readable registry or CLI output.

options.title: Defer broad guarantees
options.body: Keep current modelCatalog/probe/plugin compatibility metadata and narrow future work to specific provider regressions until maintainers want broader support commitments.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped lifecycle registry
recommendation.body: Create a provider lifecycle registry with clear owner rules, capability dimensions, deadlines, replacements, and issue links, then generate docs and doctor/models summaries from it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history across provider/model docs, models status/probe code, and prior review of this policy issue.
